title: Degree-zero formal local sections as a filtered union
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $I,J\subseteq A$ ideals, and $N$ a finite $A$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Assume $A\cong\varprojlim_n A/I^n$ via its canonical map [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Work in the ordinary module derived category $D(A)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Put $\Gamma_K(N)=\{x\in N:K^r x=0\text{ for some }r\geq1\}$, write $R\Gamma_K$ for its right derived functor, and put $H_K^i(N)=H^i(R\Gamma_K(N[0]))$ [def-sbc-ideal-power-torsion-functor]. For $L\in D(A)$ use the functorial derived completion $F_I(L)=R\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(L\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}A/I^n)$, with K-flat tensor resolutions [def-pc-kflat-complex] and the mapping fibre of $1-\mathrm{shift}$ on termwise products for the derived limit [def-weil-derived-limit], and its canonical map $\eta_L:L\to F_I(L)$. Write $V(K)=\{\mathfrak p:K\subseteq\mathfrak p\}$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Then $F_I(R\Gamma_J(N[0]))$ has zero cohomology in negative degrees, and there is a natural isomorphism
$$H^0(F_I(R\Gamma_J(N[0])))\cong\mathop{\mathrm{colim}}_{K\subseteq J,\ V(K)\cap V(I)=V(J)\cap V(I)}H_K^0(N).$$
The indexing set consists of ideals of $A$, ordered by reverse inclusion. Each transition is inclusion of torsion submodules of $N$, so the colimit is their union inside $N$. Under this identification the degree-zero completion map is the inclusion $H_J^0(N)\to\bigcup_K H_K^0(N)$.
